svg.title: Big eigenvalue means wide spread along that axis, small eigenvalue means tight spread
svg.desc: A wide oval data cloud with axes v1 and v2. Projecting the points onto v1 keeps them spread out, so lambda 1 is big. Projecting onto v2 bunches them together, so lambda 2 is small.
svg.text: long along v₁, short along v₂
points are easy to tell apart: keep
